title: Agenda setters
description: The few sites that set the news agenda, checked all day by everyone.

title: Major
description: Major national and international outlets most people know.

title: Influential
description: Well known and influential in their country or beat.

title: Established
description: Established, with a smaller audience or a narrower niche.

title: Minor
description: Minor, local or very niche sites and newsletters.

title: Unranked
description: Not ranked: the editor didn't know the site well enough to judge.

title: Unreliable
description: Low quality, or known for misinformation or made-up stories.
